archetype: The Performance Pro mixed with Swiss Brutalism (Authority, Precision, Elite Operation)

headings.rules: MUST use tracking-tight or tracking-tighter for headings > 32px. DO NOT use Inter for headings. Use fluid scaling, maximum text-6xl for main dashboard hero.

body.rules: Use for paragraphs, standard labels, and inputs. Ensure leading-relaxed for long text.

data_and_mono.rules: CRITICAL: Use for all KPIs, currency values, cost trends, metric data, and vehicle IDs. Overlines must be uppercase, text-xs, tracking-[0.2em].

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Use 'Grid Borders' strategy. Expose the skeleton with `border-collapse` layout. Data cards should have `border-r border-b border-border/40`. No drop-shadows on standard cards; rely on 1px solid strokes to separate elements.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Only for sticky headers/floating nav. Use `backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#080809]/80` with a sharp 1px bottom border. NEVER use pure transparency.
visual_enhancers.radii: Sharp edges. Use `rounded-none` or `rounded-sm` (max 2-4px) for all components to enforce the industrial/technical feel.
visual_enhancers.motion: Fast, precise micro-interactions. Hover states should feature a slight lift (`-translate-y-1`) or a 1px border color transition to primary. Avoid bouncy animations.

components.buttons: Sharp edges (`rounded-none`). Primary buttons use solid background, secondary buttons use transparent background with 1px solid border. Always configure explicit hover states (`hover:bg-primary/90 hover:text-white`).
components.dashboard_cards: Flat background (`bg-[#121214]`), 1px subtle border. No shadow by default. Organize KPIs densely. Use monospaced fonts for large metric numbers.
components.kanban_board: Ordered workflow columns (Pending, Inspecting, Maintenance, Done). Cards act as scanning surfaces (minmal data: ID, Title, Status Badge, Monospaced Cost). Show column WIP limits. Use badges for live states.
components.data_tables: Dense layout. Use Shadcn Table. Monospaced numbers for costs. Left-align most text, right-align currency/numbers.
components.checklist_builder: Multi-section form using Shadcn inputs. Use stark contrast for active/inactive items. Use `sonner` for toast notifications when checklist templates are saved.

layouts.dashboard: Mode B (High Density Grid). Base grid: `grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4`, tight gaps (`gap-4` or `gap-6`). Every pixel utilized. Summary KPI `col-span-1`, Main Cost Chart `col-span-2 row-span-2`.
layouts.vehicle_details: Bento Grid approach. A large hero cell for vehicle image + specs, adjacent cells for cost history and maintenance logs.
layouts.spacing: Generous spacing philosophy outside of the dense data grid. Use `p-6` or `p-8` for container internal padding. Avoid tight text collisions.

icons_and_assets.instructions: Use for dense dashboards. Sharp, technical aesthetic.

accessibility.contrast: Text below 18px requires 4.5:1. Interactive elements need 3:1 against background. Use text-shadow if placing text over images.
accessibility.focus: Focus states must have HIGHER contrast, e.g., `focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary focus:ring-offset-2 focus:ring-offset-background`.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., `data-testid='allocate-mechanic-button'`).

instructions_to_main_agent: Prioritize Recharts or standard Shadcn charts for all KPI cost trends. Do not use D3 unless visualizing a highly complex hierarchy.
Do not center-align layouts. Left-align text for better human readability, particularly in dense dashboards.
Use Phosphor icons. Command to install: `yarn add @phosphor-icons/react`.
Ensure `data-testid` is added to all buttons, inputs, links, and major card containers.
Avoid AI slop and generic UI. Ensure deep Obsidian backgrounds contrasted with Signal Red/Electric Green for precise, technical feeling.
Apply CSS variables provided in this configuration to `/app/frontend/src/index.css` to override default Shadcn themes.
Implement Sonner (`yarn add sonner` / Shadcn Sonner component) for all status/toast updates, like checklist completion.
universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: Avoid generic 'AI slop' aesthetic. Create distinctive frontends with edge and character.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Avoid cramped elements.
Never use pure transparent backgrounds for overlays, modals, or headers.
Do not apply `transition: all`. Target specific properties like `transition: transform 0.2s ease, opacity 0.2s ease`.
Never center-align the main App wrapper via `.App { text-align: center; }`.
Do not use placeholder image services. Use the exact URLs provided in `image_urls`.
Ensure the UI defaults to the dark theme strategy provided in this document.
